rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a very poor-quality day-5 blastocyst with poorly defined/absent ICM and TE, but it overstates some image-specific details (e.g., granular/large cells, cavity size) and shows some inconsistency around stage interpretation versus the provided 1DD grade.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, endometrium, first-cycle status, and semen findings well, and appropriately frames embryo quality as the main limiting factor.

Reasoning is mostly logical and structured, with prognosis tied to poor morphology despite favorable patient factors; minor inconsistencies remain in probability phrasing and blastocyst stage description.

Largely aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF counseling, including caution about PGT-A in a 32-year-old first cycle; a few recommendations are more speculative or not strongly guideline-driven.

Provides clear counseling for proceeding if this is the best/only embryo and sensible future-cycle steps such as embryology review, selective sperm DNA fragmentation testing, and protocol review, though some advice is somewhat broad.
